metadata.description: Universal Loomground skill packages, installable on Claude, Codex, and generic skill hosts.

plugins.name: a2a-compliance
plugins.description: Control maker agents over an A2A protocol with role authority and optional Loomground value grounding.

plugins.name: evidence-emitter
plugins.description: Emit and verify a signed, offline-verifiable governance-evidence package: compose the installed loomground assurance components (enforcement posture, effect reconciliation, norm freshness, obligation discharge, oversight certificate, governance certification, 5d-nd) into one DSSE/in-toto statement whose subject is digest-bound; absent components are marked, not faked. Attests a compliance-fleet decision or a privacy-shield scan report. Default dev signer has zero authenticity; production Ed25519 takes host key material — no key is minted or embedded.

plugins.name: loomground-deontic
plugins.description: Transcribe a natural-language norm into a verified deontic formula: split it into modality (O/P/F), bearer, and action; classify the Hohfeldian incident; resolve a 'right' as a claim or a liberty; validate with a bundled stdlib engine; and flag candidate conflicts. Transcribes and flags, never infers or resolves.

plugins.name: loomground-epistemic
plugins.description: The epistemic plane's reader: who knows or believes what, at which certainty band (K/B, holder, proposition, certainty, source). The epistemic skill is the language card; the loomground MCP server carries epistemic_extract.

plugins.name: loomground-factual
plugins.description: The factual plane's reader: lower a plain assertion into subject, predicate, object with dimension, negation and quantification. The factual skill is the language card; the loomground MCP server carries factual_lower.

plugins.name: loomground-governance
plugins.description: Express an AI-governance requirement as a verified Loomground policy-graph patch: draft the .lg patch, litmus-classify each requirement as expressible, policy, or host, and validate with the bundled validation engine. Non-normative companion skill to the Loomground standard.

plugins.name: loomground-ingest
plugins.description: Drive the network-free Loomground ingest plane: dispatch a post-acquisition artifact to the registered ingester, lower it to a dimensioned subgraph with provenance and quarantine semantics, dry-run by default, and write only through the host-injected, versioned Versum sink.

plugins.name: loomground-norm
plugins.description: The norm plane's lift: running text to RuleFacet to a rendered deontic formula, in 24 EU languages. The norm skill is the lift card with the modal-phrase table; the loomground MCP server carries norm_extract.

plugins.name: loomground-solver
plugins.description: Analytic and probabilistic reasoning skills over the Loomground Solver kernel: model opponents, track probabilities, analyse strategy, estimate liability, assess litigation risk, analyse risks, and advise on optional add-ons.

plugins.name: loomground-topos
plugins.description: lt, the legal-system topology language: systems, levels, organs, instruments, competences and their relations, with assertions by named organs. The topos skill is the language card; the loomground MCP server carries topos_parse.

plugins.name: loomground-versum
plugins.description: Loomground's human-gated knowledge-graph write path, concept-neighbour organiser, mental-model engine, and the research→graph enrichment loop, plus the read-only KG cockpit and conversational query surface over the graph.

plugins.name: policy-compiler
plugins.description: Compile a written policy into grounded deontic norms (O/P/F with bearer, action, conditions, cross-references), surfacing conflicts, undetermined rules, and unplaceable spans, and running test cases. Stops at a validated draft; activation is reserved. Delegates lowering to the loomground deontic/norm planes when present, degrading to advisory when absent. Output matches the compliance-fleet grounding seam.

plugins.name: privacy-shield
plugins.description: Detect PII and PHI locally, produce a clean overlay, and block unsafe egress before content reaches an external model.
